DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾った物をお届けになったのですね。お持ちの物を、こちらで見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have brought in something you found. May I see what you have here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵を拾いました。二本つながっていますが、使って確かめたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二本つながった鍵で試して使わず持参したと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found some keys. Two are attached together, but I have not tried using them to find out what they open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you brought two attached keys without trying to use them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのままお預かりして確認します。どこで見つけたか、わかる範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will take them as they are and check them. Please tell me where you found them, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 建物の名前はわかりません。港の方から歩いてきて、赤い看板の前で見つけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 建物名は不明だが港からの道沿いの赤い看板前で見つけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not know the building's name. I was walking from the harbor and found them in front of a red sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the building's name but found them in front of a red sign along the road from the harbor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩いてきた道を図で示していただけますか。看板以外に、近くに何がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you show the route you walked on a map? Apart from the sign, what else was nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 道を曲がる角の手前です。看板の隣に自動販売機が二台あり、鍵はその前の道路側にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がる角の手前で販売機二台の道路側にあったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was just before the corner where the road turns. There were two vending machines beside the sign, and the keys were in front of them, on the road side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that they were before the turning corner, on the road side of two vending machines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 角の手前で、自動販売機の道路側ですね。見つけた時刻は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before the corner, on the road side of the vending machines. Do you remember what time you found them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正確な分は覚えていませんが、ここへ来る二十分ほど前です。腕時計を見たのは、その後でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 約二十分前だが正確な分は不明で時計を見たのは後だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not remember the exact minute, but it was about twenty minutes before I came here. I looked at my watch afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that it was about twenty minutes earlier, you do not know the exact minute, and you checked your watch afterward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時刻はおよそのものとして伺います。鍵を拾ってから、ほかの方へ渡したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will record the time as approximate. Have you given the keys to anyone else since finding them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 誰にも渡さず、そのまま持ってきました。図には港からの道と曲がる角、販売機の位置を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 誰にも渡さず持参し港からの道と角と販売機を図に示すと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I did not give them to anyone and brought them straight here. I will draw the road from the harbor, the corner, and the vending machines on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you brought them without handing them to anyone and will mark the road from the harbor, the corner, and the vending machines on a map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所と時刻の区別がわかりました。これから届け出の案内をします。それでは、鍵はここに置いたままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I understand which details concern the location and which concern the time. I will now explain how to file the report. Please leave the keys here and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてのご相談ですね。ご自身宛ての物が届かないというお話でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about mail after moving. Is mail addressed to you failing to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ、新しい家に知らない人宛ての封筒が届きました。住所は今の家ですが、名前が私とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新居に届いた封筒は住所が合うが名前が本人と違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, an envelope addressed to someone I do not know arrived at my new home. The address is my current home, but the name is different from mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that an envelope delivered to your new home has the correct address but someone else's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 別の方宛てなのですね。封筒は開けずにお持ちになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is addressed to someone else, then. Have you brought the envelope without opening it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けずに持ってきました。前に住んでいた人かもしれませんが、私には確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開けず持参し以前の住人かは確認できないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought it unopened. It might be for someone who lived there before, but I cannot confirm that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you brought it unopened and cannot confirm whether it is for a previous resident. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 誰の物かを決めつけず、封筒の記載を見ながら対応を確認しましょう。ご自身の転居についても相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check how to handle it by looking at what is written on the envelope, without assuming who it belongs to. Do you also have a question about your own move?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の転居については別に確認したいです。この封筒の相談と、同じ用紙で進めると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の転居も相談したいが同じ用紙で進めると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to check about my own move separately. I thought I could handle that and this envelope on the same form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you also want advice about your own move but thought both matters used the same form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 扱う用件が違うので、担当者にそれぞれ説明しましょう。今日はご自身の旧住所もわかる資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: They are different matters, so please explain each one to the staff member. Have you brought anything showing your own previous address today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旧住所の資料は家にあります。今日は別人宛ての封筒の相談を先にして、自分の転居は後日にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所資料は家にあるので別人の封筒を先に相談し本人の転居は後日にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The documents for my old address are at home. Today I will ask about the envelope for someone else first, and leave my own move until another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your old-address documents are at home, so you will ask about the other person's envelope first and your own move another day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用件を分けて伺います。新しい家では、この名前の封筒が届いたのは初めてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will hear the matters separately. Is this the first envelope with this name that has arrived at your new home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この名前は初めてです。ほかの郵便物と混ぜず、開けていないことも担当者に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: この名前では初回で他と混ぜず未開封のまま担当へ伝えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is the first with this name. I will keep it separate from other mail and tell the staff member that it is unopened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that this is the first for that name, you will keep it separate, and tell the staff it remains unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、封筒の扱いを確認する担当へつなぎます。ご自身の転居相談は、資料がそろいましたらまたお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the person who checks how to handle the envelope. Please come back about your own move once your documents are ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面の途中で操作を止めたとのことですね。どのような表示が出ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You stopped partway through using the screen. What appeared on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 連絡先の番号の末尾が前の携帯電話と同じでした。今の番号ではないので、ここから進めてよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画面末尾が以前の携帯番号で今の番号と違うため進めるか迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The last digits of the contact number matched my previous mobile number. It is not my current number, so I was unsure whether to continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the final digits shown are from your old mobile number, not your current one, so you are unsure whether to proceed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習では操作を止めたまま、登録情報の確認方法を担当者に尋ねます。前の番号の電話は使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this exercise, we will leave the operation stopped and ask the staff how to check your registered information. Can you use the phone with the old number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の電話は使っていません。画面の戻る操作で自分で直せるのかと思いましたが、まだ押していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前の電話は使わず戻る操作で直せると思ったがまだ押していないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I no longer use the old phone. I thought I might be able to correct it myself by going back on the screen, but I have not pressed anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not use the old phone and thought going back might let you correct it, but have not pressed the button. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認前に押さず、表示を担当者へ説明しましょう。郵送先についても変更のご相談はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not press it before checking; explain the display to the staff. Do you also want to change the mailing address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 郵送先は今の家になっていると思います。ただ、電話番号を直すと住所も変わるのかがわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵送先は現住所と思うが電話変更で住所も変わるか不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I think the mailing address is my current home. However, I do not know whether correcting the phone number would also change the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you think the mailing address is current but do not know whether changing the phone number also changes it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 電話と住所がどう登録されているかは、別々に確認しましょう。ここで片方が自動で変わるとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the phone and address registrations separately. We cannot say here that changing one will automatically change the other.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話の登録変更を相談し、住所は今のままか確認したいです。必要な資料を持ってきているかも見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 電話変更と住所維持の確認を求め必要資料がそろうか見てもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want advice on changing the registered phone number and confirmation that the address will stay as it is. Could you also check whether I have brought the necessary documents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about changing the phone number, keeping the address, and whether you have the required documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料については担当者に確認します。手続きの案内を受けたら、変更する項目を読み合わせたいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the documents with the staff. Once you receive the instructions, it would be good to go over the items to be changed together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更する電話番号と、変えない予定の住所を分けて読み合わせます。確認が済むまで画面の操作は進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話と住所を分けて確認し確認前に画面を進めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will separately read back the phone number to change and the address I intend to leave unchanged. I will not proceed on the screen until everything is checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the phone and address separately and will not proceed on the screen before confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、登録情報を確認する担当へご案内します。画面はそのままにして、続きは担当とご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the person who checks registered information. Leave the screen as it is and discuss the next steps with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 二つの商品を比べていらっしゃいますね。量だけでなく、食べる回数も考えてお選びですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing two products. Are you considering how many times you will eat them, as well as the quantity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三日くらいに分けて食べたいです。大きい袋の方が楽だと思いましたが、開封後の表示が気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三日程度に分ける予定で大袋の開封後の表示が気になると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to eat them over about three days. I thought a large bag would be easier, but I am concerned about the instructions for after opening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to eat them over about three days and are concerned about the large bag's after-opening instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の商品では、開封後についてこの欄に書いてあります。個別包装の方は、一回分ずつ開ける型です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: For this practice product, the after-opening instructions are in this section. The individually wrapped version lets you open one serving at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きい袋を一度開けて何日も置くより、個別包装を毎回開ける方を選びたいです。中の数はどこに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一回ずつ開ける個別包装を選び内容個数の表示場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Rather than opening a large bag once and keeping it for days, I would like to choose individual packets that I open each time. Where does it say how many are inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose individual packets opened one at a time and ask where the packet count is shown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正面の下の欄に個数があります。小さい包み一つで、どのくらい食べる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The number is in the lower section on the front. How much do you plan to eat from one small packet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一回に一包みです。二人で食べる日もあるので、三包みだけでは足りないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一回一包みだが二人の日もあり三包みでは不足しそうと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One packet each time. There are days when two of us will eat it, so three packets may not be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you eat one packet at a time, but sometimes two people eat, so three packets may be insufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 人数も含めて数えたいですね。一包みの量はこちらの内容量の表示で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You should count the number of people too. You can check the amount in each packet in this net-content information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 個数と一包みの量を両方見ます。開封前に置く場所の説明は、開封後とは別の欄でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 個数と一包みの量を見て開封前の保管説明が別欄か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check both the number and the amount per packet. Are the instructions on where to keep it before opening in a different section from those for after opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check packet count and amount and ask whether storage before opening is explained separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保存の表示も読んでみましょう。開封前と後で同じ条件だと決めつけず、書かれている説明を分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us read the storage instructions too. Do not assume the conditions are the same before and after opening; distinguish the written instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 個別包装を選び、個数と量、開ける前後の表示を分けて確認します。二人で食べる分も足して数えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個別包装の個数と量と開封前後の条件を分けて確認し二人分も数えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose individual packets and separately check their count, amount, and the instructions before and after opening. I will add the portions for the days when two people eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will separately check individual packet count, amount, and storage conditions before and after opening, including enough for two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 表示を比べながら決められましたね。それでは、必要な数がそろいましたらレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have made your choice by comparing the labels. Once you have enough, please take them to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 水辺の方をご覧になる予定ですか。雨の後なので、歩く道の様子も確認しておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to look around the waterside? It has rained, so let us check the condition of the paths too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水面の写真を撮りたいです。革の靴で来たので、土の道へ入らずに見られる場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水面を撮りたいが革靴なので土道に入らず見られる場所を探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to photograph the surface of the water. I came in leather shoes, so I am looking for somewhere I can see it without going onto a dirt path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to photograph the water but, because you have leather shoes, want a viewpoint without entering a dirt path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の図では、入口から広場までが舗装路です。水辺へ下りる道は土の道として描かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice map, the route from the entrance to the square is paved. The path down to the water is shown as a dirt path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水辺まで下りるのはやめて、広場から撮りたいです。広場から水が見えるか、現地で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 水辺へ下りず広場から撮り水が見えるか現地で確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not go down to the water; I would like to take photos from the square. I will check there whether the water is visible from it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will photograph from the square without going down to the water and check the view on site. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 広場の表示を見ながら確認してください。写真を撮った後は、休憩もご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check while following the square's signs. Are you also planning a rest after taking photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 少し座って靴の状態を見たいです。土の道を通らずに行ける休憩場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座って靴を確認したいので土道なしで行く休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to sit for a while and check my shoes. Is there a rest area I can reach without using a dirt path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a rest area reachable without a dirt path, where you can sit and check your shoes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 図の入口近くに屋根付きの休憩所があります。広場から入口へ戻る舗装路で向かう案はいかがでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a covered rest area near the entrance on the map. How about returning from the square toward the entrance on the paved path?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ舗装路で入口側へ戻ります。途中で水たまりが大きければ、無理に進まず写真もあきらめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ舗装路で戻り大きな水たまりなら進まず撮影をあきらめると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will return toward the entrance on the same paved path. If there is a large puddle along the way, I will not push on and will give up taking photos too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will return by the same paved path and, if there is a large puddle, will stop and abandon the photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通りにくい所を見つけたら、場所を係に知らせてください。撮れる写真より足元の確認を先にしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you find a difficult spot, please tell the staff where it is. Check your footing before thinking about the pictures you can take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に足元を見て、通りにくければ場所を知らせます。今日は広場と入口側の休憩所だけを目標にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 足元を先に確認し難所を係に知らせ広場と入口側休憩所に範囲を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check my footing first and report the location if it is difficult to pass. Today I will limit my destinations to the square and the rest area near the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your footing first, report difficult spots to staff, and limit your trip to the square and entrance-side rest area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図をお持ちください。道の表示を見ながらゆっくりどうぞ。それでは、お帰りまで足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the map. Go slowly, following the path signs. Take care of your footing until you get home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札へ向かわれますか。階段の前で立ち止まっていらっしゃいましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you heading to the ticket gates? You were standing still in front of the stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この階段が近そうですが、大きな荷物が二つあり、持って上がるのは難しいです。別の道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大きな荷物二つで階段を上がれず別経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: These stairs seem close, but I have two large pieces of luggage and cannot easily carry them up. Is there another route?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for another route because you have two large bags and cannot take them up the stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内図では、奥にエレベーターがあります。荷物を引いて移動できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This map shows an elevator farther inside. Can you pull your luggage along?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 平らなところなら引けます。エレベーターまでの曲がり角を、図で指してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 平らな道なら荷物を引けると述べエレベーターまでの角を示してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can on level ground. Could you point out on the map the corner on the way to the elevator?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can pull the luggage on level ground and ask to be shown the corner leading to the elevator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図のこの角です。実際の表示も確かめながら進みましょう。誰かと待合せされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is this corner on the map. Please check the actual signs as you go too. Are you meeting someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人を階段の上で待たせています。そちらへ上がらず、エレベーター側で会うと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段上の友人にエレベーター側で会うと連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend is waiting at the top of the stairs. I will tell them I will not go up there and will meet them by the elevator instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your friend waiting above the stairs that you will meet on the elevator side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合流する場所は具体的に伝えるとよいですね。降りてから改札までの道も見ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is best to give a specific meeting point. Shall we also look at the route from where you get off the elevator to the gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見たいです。降りたらすぐ改札だと思っていたので、どちらへ進むか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札が直後だと思っていたためエレベーターを降りた後の方向を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. I thought the gates would be right there after getting off, so I want to check which direction to go.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you thought the gates were immediately after the elevator and want to check the direction after getting off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 図の矢印をたどってみてください。途中の表示で分からなくなったらどうされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Try following the arrows on the map. What will you do if the signs become unclear along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を通路の端に寄せて立ち止まり、近くの係員に改札への方向を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を端へ寄せて止まり係員に改札方向を聞くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move my luggage to the side of the passage, stop, and ask a nearby staff member which way the gates are.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you will move your luggage aside, stop, and ask staff for the direction of the gates. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、道を確かめながらお進みください。荷物の車輪にも気を付けて、よいご旅行を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, check the route as you go. Watch the luggage wheels too, and have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居についてのご相談ですね。ご家族皆さまで同じ日に移られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice about moving. Did your whole family move on the same day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族は先週移りましたが、私は仕事のため旧居に残り、昨日新居へ移りました。同じ日付で書いてよいか迷います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族は先週で自分は昨日と伝え同一日付で記入してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My family moved last week, but I stayed at the old home for work and moved into the new home yesterday. I am unsure whether I can write the same date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your family moved last week and you moved yesterday, and ask whether you may enter the same date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの状況を担当に伝えて確認しましょう。メモに二つの日付を分けて書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us explain each situation to the person in charge and check. Can you write the two dates separately in a note?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家族の移った日と、私が移った日を別の行に書きます。旧居の住所も添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族と自分の転居日を別行にして旧住所も書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will write my family's moving date and mine on separate lines. I will add the old address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the family and your own moving dates on separate lines and include the old address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状況が伝わりやすくなります。今お持ちの書類は、ご自身のものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That will make the situation easier to explain. Are the documents you have with you your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の書類だけです。家族の手続きがどうなっているかは、まだ聞けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の書類のみで家族の手続き状況は未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Only my own documents. I have not yet asked how my family's procedures are going.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you have only your own documents and have not confirmed the family's procedure status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分からない点は分からないとお伝えください。家族へ連絡して確認できそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please say when there is something you do not know. Could you contact your family to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩時間なら電話できます。済ませた手続きの名前と、受け取った案内があるかを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休憩時に手続き名と受領した案内を家族に電話で聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can call during my break. I will ask the names of the procedures they completed and whether they received any instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Call your family during a break to ask the procedure names and what instructions they received. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 返答も合わせて担当に相談しましょう。今日はどの点を先に確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Discuss their reply with the staff too. What would you like to check first today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず自分の状況に合う窓口と持ち物を確認し、家族と同じ扱いだと決めつけず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族と同じと判断せず自分の窓口と持ち物を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I want to check the counter and documents appropriate for my own situation, without assuming my case is treated the same as my family's.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check your own counter and required documents without assuming the same treatment as your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。日付のメモと書類をそろえてご案内します。ご家族への確認も忘れずに、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you once you have your date note and documents together. Remember to check with your family, and take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約の紙を見せていただけますか。変更したいのは、どちらの予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I see your appointment paper? Which appointment would you like to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この診察の日に仕事が入りました。上に検査の予定もありますが、二つとも同じように変えてよいのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察日が仕事と重なり検査も一緒に変えてよいか分からないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have work on this consultation date. There is also a test appointment above it, but I do not know whether I may change both in the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the consultation conflicts with work and you do not know whether to change the test at the same time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査と診察の関係は担当に確認が必要です。まず、都合の悪い日を指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The relationship between the test and consultation needs to be checked with the person in charge. First, could you point to the date that does not suit you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの診察日です。検査の日は予定どおり来られますが、別々に変えられるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察日を指し検査日は来られるため別々に変更できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This consultation date. I can come for the test as scheduled, but I would like to ask whether they can be changed separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the consultation date and ask whether it can be changed separately, since you can attend the test. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。変更の希望日については、どこまで予定が分かっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass that request on. How much do you know about your availability for a replacement date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週の午前なら候補を聞けます。空きがあると思い込まず、確認してから職場へ連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 来週午前の候補を希望し確認後に職場へ連絡したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I could consider options next week in the morning. I do not want to assume a slot is free; I want to check first and then contact my workplace.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want morning options next week and will contact work after checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が済むまでは元の予約を変わったものとして扱わないでください。紙に書き込むのは待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Until confirmation is complete, do not treat the original appointment as changed. Please wait before writing on the paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の時刻は消さずに残します。変更が決まったら、検査と診察の両方の予定を読み返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻を消さず変更確定後に検査と診察の両方を読み返す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave the original time without erasing it. Once the change is decided, I will read back both the test and consultation schedules.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not erase the time and will reread both test and consultation appointments after the change is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その際、検査の案内にも変更があるか確認してください。今、案内の内容で質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please also check whether the test instructions have changed. Do you have any questions about those instructions now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は予約の組合せだけを相談したいです。案内が変わる場合は、担当から説明を聞いてメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約の組合せを相談し検査案内の変更は担当説明をメモすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: For now I only want to discuss the combination of appointments. If the instructions change, I will listen to the staff's explanation and take notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you want to discuss how the appointments fit together and will note the staff's explanation of changed test instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、変更の相談先へつなぎます。確認した予定をお持ちになって、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the appointment-change desk. Take the confirmed schedule with you, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないのですね。最後に停めた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find your bicycle. Please tell me where you last parked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 施設の入口の横です。ただ、入口が二つあるので、今探した場所が正しいか自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの入口があり探した場所が正しいか自信がないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Beside the facility entrance. However, there are two entrances, so I am not confident that the place I just searched is the right one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that there are two entrances and you are unsure whether you searched the correct place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 停めたときの写真や、近くの目印はありますか。分かる範囲から確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a photo from when you parked it or a nearby landmark? Let us check from what you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人を撮った写真に自転車が写っています。後ろに自動販売機があるので、そちらの入口だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の写真の自転車と自販機から入口を特定したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bicycle appears in a photo I took of my friend. There is a vending machine behind it, so I think it was that entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to identify the entrance using the bicycle and vending machine in your friend's photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の目印で場所を確かめられますね。自転車の色と特徴も伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The landmarks in the photo can help check the place. Could you also tell me the bicycle's color and features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、前のかごの右側が少し曲がっています。似た車体と間違えないよう、その点を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀色とかご右側の曲がりを伝え似た車体と区別すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is silver, and the right side of the front basket is slightly bent. I will check that to avoid confusing it with a similar bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe its silver color and bent right side of the basket to distinguish it from similar bicycles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 施設の管理の方には、置いた場所や移動の案内について尋ねましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you asked the facility management about where you left it and any information on moved bicycles?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ尋ねていません。勝手に盗まれたと決めず、写真を見せて駐輪場所と案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 盗難と断定せず管理者に写真で駐輪場所と移動案内を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. Without deciding on my own that it was stolen, I will show the photo and check the parking location and notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not conclude it was stolen and will show the photo to management to ask about parking and relocation notices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した結果もお知らせください。車体番号が分かる書類は手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know the result too. Do you have any documents showing the frame number with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は持っていません。家にある購入時の書類を探し、番号と写真をそろえて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入書類を家で探し車体番号と写真をそろえると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not now. I will look for the purchase documents at home and bring the number and photos together for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will find the purchase documents at home and assemble the frame number and photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。分かった場所と車体情報を整理してご相談ください。戻るときも、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please organize the confirmed location and bicycle information before discussing it. Take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申込みの書類を送るご相談ですね。送り先から方法の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want advice on sending application documents. Has the recipient specified a method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 配達の記録が残る方法と書いてあります。追跡できるものなら何でもよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配達記録という指定を追跡できればよいと思っていたと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says to use a method that leaves a delivery record. I thought anything that could be tracked would be fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought the requirement for a delivery record meant any trackable method was acceptable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その言葉で何を求めているかは、送り先にも確認するとよいですね。案内文はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It would be good to check with the recipient what they mean by that wording. Do you have the instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。番号で状況を調べられることと、相手への配達を記録することの違いを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内文を示し状況追跡と配達の記録の違いを確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This paper. I would like to check the difference between checking progress with a number and recording delivery to the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the instructions and ask about the difference between tracking progress and recording delivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な記録が分かれば方法の候補を説明できます。提出の日付については、どう書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once we know what record is needed, we can explain possible methods. What does it say about the submission date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この日までに届くこととあります。出す日の期限だと思っていたので、到着の条件も読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出す日ではなく届く日が指定されていると気づき読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says it must arrive by this day. I thought it was the posting deadline, so I will reread the arrival conditions too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Realize that the specified date is for arrival rather than posting, and reread it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 方法だけでなく到着の条件も確認しましょう。今日、すぐに発送したいご事情がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the arrival conditions as well as the method. Is there a reason you need to send it immediately today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 用意はできていますが、指定を満たさない方法で出したくありません。先に送り先へ電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 準備済みでも指定を満たすため先に送り先へ電話すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Everything is ready, but I do not want to send it by a method that fails the requirements. I will call the recipient first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to call the recipient first to meet the requirements, even though everything is ready. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 電話では、必要な記録の種類と到着の条件を聞くとよいですね。封筒はまだ閉じていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: On the phone, ask what kind of record is needed and the arrival conditions. Have you not sealed the envelope yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ閉じていません。返答をメモし、宛先と中の書類も確かめてから発送方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返答をメモして宛先と中身を確認後に発送方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not yet. I will note the reply, check the address and enclosed documents, and then ask about the sending method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the reply and check the destination and contents before asking about the sending method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、確認の返答をお持ちください。発送のご相談はその後に進めましょう。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring their confirmed reply. We will discuss sending it afterward. Take care on your way home.
